title: AI can make tech CEOs’ lives easier. What about everyone else?
slides: Can AI serve everyone, not just tech CEOs?
CEOs get personalized tools while rank-and-file wait
But AI may actually automate middle management first
Your workload could shift toward oversight, not less work
Ask your boss what AI tool you'll actually get
thread_text:
1. Who gets the good AI?

CEOs are already testing personalized AI assistants while most employees still wait for basic access. The gap is widening, not closing.

2. The real automation target

Middle management is first in line, not factory floors. Their coordination tasks are exactly what AI handles best.

3. Your job becomes supervision

You won't do less work. You'll check AI output, fix errors, and manage systems that never sleep.

4. The oversight trap

Less hands-on work sounds good until you realize you're accountable for AI mistakes you didn't make. That's not freedom.

5. Ask about your tools

Ask your boss this week: what AI tool will I actually get, and when? If there's no answer, that tells you something.
